latency_d14.methodology: Serial Graphiti MCP calls (search_memory_facts then get_episodes per case, never concurrent); local disk-index reads overlap remote IO and are measured separately. First-call (cold session) vs warm captured. Quantiles: nearest-rank on the per-case sample (p50 = median of 20; p95 = 95th percentile). n stated per measurement. Censored cases: N03/N04 (native safe-text rejection) made no remote calls; their e2e samples are ~0 ms and included in the e2e n=20 distribution.
